summary: XPeng Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the grant of 1,255,122 restricted share units (RSUs) to 47 employees under its 2025 Share Incentive Scheme. The RSUs have a nil purchase price, with a closing price of HK$52.55 per share on the grant date, and vest over service-based schedules ranging from 2026 to 2030. None of the grantees are directors, CEO, or substantial shareholders. The filing is a routine equity compensation disclosure, not a special situation transaction.
